result.note: Tests the outlay, sector and demand-guarantee mechanism of the GOBARdhan compressed biogas scheme approved by the Cabinet.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about the GOBARdhan scheme approved in August 2026:
items: It was approved by the Cabinet with an outlay of INR 237 billion.
It is a scheme for compressed biogas.
It guarantees producers a buyer through city-gas blending obligations that rise every year.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: All three are correct. On 7 August 2026 the Cabinet approved GOBARdhan, an INR 237 billion (USD 2.5 billion) compressed biogas scheme. Demand is secured through city-gas blending obligations that rise every year.
questions.source: The Cabinet approved GOBARdhan, a INR 237 billion (USD 2.5 billion) compressed biogas scheme, guaranteeing producers a buyer through city-gas blending obligations that rise every year.
